comment: The weight knobs of the seventh and eighth slots are swapped: the parameter enum lists WEIGHT8 before WEIGHT7, while the weight used for slot n is params[n] and the lights and edit buttons are in panel order. So the knob drawn above the seventh light weights the eighth slot and the other way round. The guard that is meant to stop an edit button from aborting a recording of the slot already selected compares a parameter index with a slot number, so it never matches and the press always abandons the recording.
